shot.action: Seconds 0–1.5 same intact aircraft flies forward in heavy rain. At 1.5 seconds a SINGLE bright lightning BOLT visibly connects storm cloud to RIGHT ENGINE beside camera, with one thunderclap. The right engine immediately catches a sustained small orange fire with continuous black smoke. Right propeller stops. From 2–6 seconds aircraft loses thrust, banks and pitches NOSE DOWN steeply as in tail image. Fire and smoke MUST persist through last frame. Never recover to level flight, never extinguish fire. Track same aircraft, ample high altitude above island for safe escape in next scene. No explosion or strobe, no people.
